svg.title: Bench test wiring schematic
svg.desc: An ESP32 Feather sends a 3.3 volt data signal from GPIO 27 through a 74AHCT125 level shifter powered from the Feather's 5 volt USB pin, then through a 470 ohm resistor to the data input of a WS2815 LED strip. A separate 12 volt supply powers the strip through its power leads, with a 1000 microfarad capacitor across the supply and a 0.1 microfarad capacitor across the level shifter supply. All grounds are one shared net.
svg.text: ground (all ground symbols are one net)
